# Owner instruction — entered 2026-10-16

MAGNIVIS — CYCLE #17: SS OHIO / OPERATION PEDESTAL

Begin Cycle #17 with the selected candidate: the extraordinary survival and arrival of SS Ohio during Operation Pedestal, August 1942. Investigate the historical reality and strongest accurate version. Working hook, a hypothesis requiring verification: "This ship was so badly damaged that other warships had to hold it up to get it into port." Do not assert that the vessel was literally cut in half.

Create a premium cinematic approximately 35–50-second educational Short: immediate visual opening, clear stakes, coherent damage/arrival explanation, physical relationship of assisting ships, powerful arrival payoff and memorable understanding. Research before locking narrative. Use authoritative archives, museums, official histories and credible scholarship; verify damage, assistance, timeline, fuel and significance. Distinguish confirmed facts, disputed details and popular retellings. No invented dialogue, casualty figures, mechanisms or incidents. Evaluate archive availability and rights. Historically grounded imagery plus purposeful animation or identified reconstruction; no generic footage, slideshow, repetitive moves, fake archive or decorative animation. Established Magnivis typography, af_heart narration, captions and identity; inspect capabilities/assets before technique choice.

Inspect repository and latest workflow/history, preserve existing work and approvals, verify no conflict. Research and develop the strongest evidence-backed narrative and visuals. If editorial/research gates clear, proceed through established production workflow to complete V1 master candidate, automated media/factual/caption/visual QA and concise owner master-review handoff with exact narration/runtime/path/hashes/evidence/visual decisions/limits/next action. Stop if premise materially misleading or defensible convincing production unavailable.

Proceed with Cycle #17 research and, if justified, V1 production. Stop at owner master review. No four-platform delivery packages yet. No upload, scheduling, publication or published status. No changes to earlier approved masters or historical evidence. No commit/push absent applicable explicit authorization; leave changes for review.

Faithful scope transcription of the supplied owner message; entry date records intake, not an invented owner review timestamp. Exact message remains in this session.
